ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the lines $AB, IL, JK, DC$ are parallel to each other, and the lines $AD, IJ, LK, BC$ are also parallel to each other. The area of the quadrilateral $ABCD$ is 60, and the area of quadrilateral $EFGH$ is 35. What is the area of quadrilateral $IJKL$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since lines $AB$, $IL$, $JK$, $DC$ are parallel to each other, and lines $AD$, $IJ$, $LK$, $BC$ are parallel to each other, \\
therefore, quadrilaterals AFJE, DGKF, CHLG, BEIH are parallelograms, \\
therefore, $S_{\triangle AEF}=S_{\triangle EFJ}$, $S_{\triangle BEH}=S_{\triangle EHI}$, $S_{\triangle CHG}=S_{\triangle HGL}$, $S_{\triangle DGF}=S_{\triangle GFK}$, \\
since the area of quadrilateral $ABCD$ is 60, and the area of quadrilateral $EFGH$ is 35, \\
therefore, $S_{\triangle AEF}+S_{\triangle BEH}+S_{\triangle CHG}+S_{\triangle DGF}=25$, \\
therefore, $S_{\triangle EFJ}+S_{\triangle EHI}+S_{\triangle HGL}+S_{\triangle GFK}=25$, \\
therefore, $S_{\text{quadrilateral }IJKL}=S_{\text{quadrilateral }EFGH}-(S_{\triangle EFJ}+S_{\triangle EHI}+S_{\triangle HGL}+S_{\triangle GFK})=35-25=\boxed{10}$.

method.method_draft: Use an affine-coordinate normalization. From the diagram, E is on AB, F on AD, G on DC, H on BC, and IJKL is formed by the two lines through E and G parallel to AD/BC and the two lines through F and H parallel to AB/DC. Since affine maps preserve parallelism and area ratios, map ABCD to the unit square with D=(0,0), C=(1,0), A=(0,1), B=(1,1). Write E=(x,1), F=(0,y), G=(u,0), H=(1,v), with u>x and v>y as shown. Then IJKL becomes the rectangle with corners (x,v), (x,y), (u,y), (u,v), so its normalized area is q=(u-x)(v-y). Compute the normalized area of EFGH by the shoelace formula in the cyclic order E,F,G,H: p=1/2[1+(u-x)(v-y)]=1/2(1+q). The text gives p=35/60=7/12, so q=2p-1=1/6. method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中外层四边形 ABCD 是一个平行四边形，A、B 在上边，D、C 在下边；E 位于 AB 上，F 位于 AD 上，G 位于 DC 上，H 位于 BC 上。图中有两组平行线：AB、IL、JK、DC 互相平行，AD、IJ、LK、BC 互相平行。内部四边形 IJKL 由经过 E、G 且平行于 AD/BC 的两条线，以及经过 F、H 且平行于 AB/DC 的两条线围成。

推理：采用仿射坐标归一化。仿射变换保持平行关系，并保持面积比，所以可把平行四边形 ABCD 映到单位正方形：D=(0,0), C=(1,0), A=(0,1), B=(1,1)。设 E=(x,1), F=(0,y), G=(u,0), H=(1,v)。由图中位置取 u>x, v>y。经过 E、G 且平行于 AD/BC 的线分别为 x=x 与 x=u；经过 F、H 且平行于 AB/DC 的线分别为 y=y 与 y=v。因此 IJKL 在归一化后是矩形，其面积为 q=(u-x)(v-y)。

计算 EFGH 的归一化面积。按 E,F,G,H 的顺序用鞋带公式：E=(x,1), F=(0,y), G=(u,0), H=(1,v)。面积 p=1/2[(xy+uv+1)-(yu+vx)] = 1/2[1+(u-x)(v-y)] = 1/2(1+q)。已知原图中 area(ABCD)=60，area(EFGH)=35，所以 p=35/60=7/12。于是 7/12=1/2(1+q)，得 1+q=7/6，q=1/6。还原到原面积尺度，area(IJKL)=60·q=60·1/6=10。

计算 EFGH 的归一化面积。按 E,F,G,H 的顺序用鞋带公式：E=(x,1), F=(0,y), G=(u,0), H=(1,v)。面积 p=1/2[(xy+uv+1)-(yu+vx)] = 1/2[1+(u-x)(v-y)] = 1/2(1+q)。已知原图中 area(ABCD)=60，area(EFGH)=35，所以 p=35/60=7/12。于是 7/12=1/2(1+q)，得 1+q=7/6，q=1/6。还原到原面积尺度，area(IJKL)=60·q=60·1/6=10。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, the lines $AB, IL, JK, DC$ are parallel to each other, and the lines $AD, IJ, LK, BC$ are also parallel to each other. The area of the quadrilateral $ABCD$ is 60, and the area of quadrilateral $EFGH$ is 35. What is the area of quadrilateral $IJKL$?
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} Since lines $AB$, $IL$, $JK$, $DC$ are parallel to each other, and lines $AD$, $IJ$, $LK$, $BC$ are parallel to each other,
therefore, quadrilaterals AFJE, DGKF, CHLG, BEIH are parallelograms,
therefore, $S_{\triangle AEF}=S_{\triangle EFJ}$, $S_{\triangle BEH}=S_{\triangle EHI}$, $S_{\triangle CHG}=S_{\triangle HGL}$, $S_{\triangle DGF}=S_{\triangle GFK}$,
since the area of quadrilateral $ABCD$ is 60, and the area of quadrilateral $EFGH$ is 35,
therefore, $S_{\triangle AEF}+S_{\triangle BEH}+S_{\triangle CHG}+S_{\triangle DGF}=25$,
therefore, $S_{\triangle EFJ}+S_{\triangle EHI}+S_{\triangle HGL}+S_{\triangle GFK}=25$,
therefore, $S_{\text{quadrilateral }IJKL}=S_{\text{quadrilateral }EFGH}-(S_{\triangle EFJ}+S_{\triangle EHI}+S_{\triangle HGL}+S_{\triangle GFK})=35-25=\boxed{10}$.
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure, the outer layer is parallelogram ABCD, A and B are on the upper side, D and C are on the lower side; E is on AB, F is on AD, G is on DC, and H is on BC. In the figure there is a group of horizontal lines parallel to AB and DC, including the line passing through I and L and the line passing through J and K; there is also a group of slanted lines parallel to AD and BC, including the line passing through I and J and the line passing through L and K. Connecting E, F, G, and H obtains quadrilateral EFGH, and inside, these parallel lines enclose quadrilateral IJKL.
Reasoning: From the parallel relationships it can be known that AFJE, BEIH, CHLG, and DGKF are all parallelograms. The diagonals of a parallelogram divide it into two triangles of equal area, so S(△AEF)=S(△EFJ), S(△BEH)=S(△EHI), S(△CHG)=S(△HGL), S(△DGF)=S(△GFK). The area of the outer ABCD is 60, and the area of the inner quadrilateral EFGH is 35, therefore the sum of the areas of the four corner triangles inside ABCD but outside EFGH is 60-35=25, namely S(△AEF)+S(△BEH)+S(△CHG)+S(△DGF)=25. From the above equal-area relationships, the sum of the areas of the four corresponding triangles inside EFGH but outside IJKL is also 25. Therefore S(IJKL)=S(EFGH)-25=35-25=10.
